title: FTP UGM Holds International Guest Lecture: Exploring the Future of Agricultural Engineering Profession in the Era of IR 4.0
excerpt: The Department of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering, Faculty of Agricultural Technology Universitas Gadjah Mada (FTP UGM) is proud to present an international guest lecture with the theme "The Future of Agricultural Engineering Profession: Challenges and Potentials in the Era of IR 4.0". The event will be held on: Date: Wednesday, 12 February…
body:
The Department of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering, Faculty of Agricultural Technology Universitas Gadjah Mada (FTP UGM) is proud to present an international guest lecture with the theme "The Future of Agricultural Engineering Profession: Challenges and Potentials in the Era of IR 4.0". The event will be held on:

-   **Date/Time:** Wednesday, 12 February 2025
-   **Time:** 13:00 – 14:30 WIB
-   **Venue:** Meeting Room 384, FTP UGM

This guest lecture will feature an international speaker, Assoc. Prof. Dr. Nazmi Mat Nawi, who serves as Head of the Department of Biological and Agricultural Engineering at Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM). He will share his insights and expertise regarding the challenges and opportunities faced by agricultural engineering professionals in the era of Industry Revolution 4.0. The event will be moderated by Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, Ph.D., IPU., ASEAN Eng, research coordinator of the Smart Agriculture Research Center, Department of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering, FTP UGM.

This guest lecture is mandatory for students taking the Engineering Profession course (TPPB212207). The event is also open to the public and presents a valuable opportunity for students, lecturers, researchers, and practitioners in the field of agriculture to expand their knowledge and discuss the latest developments in the world of agricultural engineering.

This activity is part of the Joint Supervision and Research Program between Universitas Gadjah Mada and Universiti Putra Malaysia, which aims to strengthen research and academic cooperation between the two institutions.

For further information, please contact Instagram @smartagri.ugm or email: smartagri@ugm.ac.id.

original.body:
Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian Universitas Gadjah Mada (FTP UGM) dengan bangga mempersembahkan kuliah tamu internasional dengan tema “The Future of Agricultural Engineering Profession: Challenges and Potentials in the Era of IR 4.0”. Acara ini akan diselenggarakan pada:

-   **Hari/Tanggal:** Rabu, 12 Februari 2025
-   **Waktu:** 13:00 – 14:30 WIB
-   **Tempat:** Ruang Sidang 384 FTP UGM

Kuliah tamu ini akan menghadirkan narasumber internsional, Assoc. Prof. Dr. Nazmi Mat Nawi, yang menjabat sebagai Head Department of Biological and Agricultural Engineering di Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM). Beliau akan berbagi wawasan dan keahliannya mengenai tantangan dan peluang yang dihadapi oleh para profesional teknik pertanian di era Revolusi Industri 4.0. Acara ini akan dimoderatori oleh Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, Ph.D., IPU., ASEAN Eng, koordinator peneliti Smart Agriculture Research Center, Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem FTP UGM.

Kuliah tamu ini wajib dihadiri oleh mahasiswa yang mengambil mata kuliah Profesi Keteknikan (TPPB212207). Acara ini juga terbuka untuk umum dan menjadi kesempatan berharga bagi mahasiswa, dosen, peneliti, dan praktisi di bidang pertanian untuk memperluas pengetahuan dan berdiskusi mengenai perkembangan terkini di dunia _agricultural engineering_.

Kegiatan ini merupakan bagian dari program _Joint Supervision and Research Program_ antara Universitas Gadjah Mada dan Universiti Putra Malaysia, yang bertujuan untuk memperkuat kerjasama riset dan akademik antara kedua institusi.

Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, silakan hubungi Instagram @smartagri.ugm atau email: smartagri@ugm.ac.id.
